payload.fact: FavTrip says its staged-authority billing agent found a $25,000 fuel-invoice error after first operating read-only and later emailing vetted vendors with the owner copied.
payload.expected: A notable AI-agent win would come from an ambitious autonomous or customer-facing task.
payload.actual: The clearest reported win was checking a bill, with authority added in stages.
payload.tension: A mundane control task produced the memorable result while the agent remained bounded.
payload.target: The tendency to overlook small back-office checks while chasing flashy AI use cases.
payload.reader_realization: Useful AI can look like careful invoice reconciliation, not theatrical autonomy.

angles.line: The memorable AI-agent result was the unglamorous work of checking a fuel bill.
The agent could contact vendors only after read-only testing, and only from a vetted list with the owner copied.
A three-store chain found a claimed $25,000 error by automating invoice reconciliation.
The agent looked autonomous only after a sequence of narrow permissions and human visibility.
The valuable AI agent was an accounts-payable control, not a content machine.
